headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 6, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a close game, securing their win. The New York Mets secured a convincing victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning the game 13-6. The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Luinder Avila, a right-handed pitcher for the Kansas City Royals, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness. Blake Dunn, a center fielder for the Cincinnati Reds, has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow sprain. Ryan Thompson, a right-handed pitcher for the Arizona Diamondbacks, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a strained lower back. Hunter Greene, a right-handed pitcher for the Cincinnati Reds, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 2, 2026, due to right elbow soreness. Sam Bachman, a right-handed pitcher for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 3, 2026, due to right forearm radial nerve inflammation.

The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Miami Marlins have traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Philadelphia Phillies have traded right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson to the Athletics for right fielder Colby Thomas.
